title: PSR 00 343 sugarcane (PHILSURIN 00 343): Characteristics
metaDescription: PSR 00 343 sugarcane is a polycross clone of VMC 84 947 sugarcane variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: PSR 00 343 sugarcane is a polycross clone of VMC 84 947 sugarcane variety, also sold or known as PHILSURIN 00 343. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from PHILSURIN (Philippine Sugar Research Institute Foundation).

heroImage.alt: Cane setts laid in deep furrows on red soil, the start of a sugarcane crop, the kind of farm where PSR 00 343 sugarcane is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for PHILSURIN 00 343, this is the same sugarcane. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sugarcane variety finder](/crop-varieties/sugarcane), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for sugarcane](/land-preparation/sugarcane-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sugarcane fields most often: [Rice field rats](/pests/rice-field-rats), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [white grub](/pests/white-grub). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** About 120 TC/ha, 2.22 LKg per ton cane.
**Fruit:** Tall, thin to medium brownish purple stalks.
**Where:** Most mill districts, incl. Victorias, San Carlos, Bukidnon, Davao, La Carlota, Bago, Batangas, Silay.
Highly resistant to smut and rust, resistant to yellow spot.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: PHILSURIN's 2010 release recommended for most mill districts. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant PSR 00 343 sugarcane

Mills pay for sugar, not cane, so compare the sugar yield in LKg per hectare as well as the tonnes of cane. Pick a variety that ratoons well, and one rated against smut and downy mildew, the diseases that cut a ratoon crop short. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation in the Philippines](/land-preparation/land-preparation-philippines).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is PHILSURIN 00 343 the same as PSR 00 343?
items.a: Yes. PHILSURIN 00 343 is another name for PSR 00 343. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of PSR 00 343?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
